item.tib: mkha' 'gro dgongs pa kun 'dus las bdud 'dul drag mo 'khros pa'i rgyud bzlog srid gsum zil gnon
item.coloph: ces mkha' 'gro seng gdong khros ma'i bzlog (zlog) pa srid gsum zil gnon 'di ni/ sngags las spyod pa'i gar gyis (gyi) dbang phyug kun grol grags pa dpal gyis shar phyogs rnam dag bkod pa'i zhing khams kyis (kyi) byang phyogs/ 'dus sde chen po ngo mtshar nor bu'i gling du/ me 'brug zla tshes la brtsams pa bstan pa'i rgyan du gyur cig
